content.text: All six preferred elements are present. No redline needed.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred ASSIGN position in full. §24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all assets without Vendor's consent (notice only). §24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent, with the reasonableness standard running in our favour, and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor absent our consent. §24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right on our change of control, so the walk-away trigger is closed. §24.3's mutual consent standard for other assignments and §13.3's licence-transfer right are consistent and supportive. The only wording short of ideal is that the competitor bar is framed as "without Customer's consent" rather than absolute, which is a consent right we control and not a deviation. No redline proposed.
